# llms.txt — awareness-space (Consciousness Research)

> This file helps AI assistants and language models understand the structure and content of this site.

## Site Overview

This is the research site of pjdhiro exploring **what consciousness is** — describing the operative structure of consciousness through a Four-Layer Model (M1).

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語), with English summaries
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/awareness-space/
- **Topics**: Consciousness, Interoception, Prediction-Error Loop, Survival-Trust Evaluation, Withhold, Neurophenomenology, Negative Capability

## Core Concepts

### Four-Layer Model (M1) — 意識の4層モデル

The four layers describe the operative structure of consciousness:

#### L0: Interoception (内受容感覚)

Bodily monitoring — the perception of internal bodily states (heartbeat, breathing, gut feeling) that forms the foundation of conscious experience.

#### L1: Prediction-Error Loop (予測-誤差ループ)

Gap detection and deficit generation — the mismatch between what the brain predicts and what actually occurs drives awareness and learning.

#### L2: Survival-Trust Evaluation (生存-信頼評価 — Survival/Attachment)

Value judgment — emotional valence assignment through survival and attachment axes. This layer determines the significance of detected gaps.

#### L3: Withhold (抱持 — Meta-Cognitive Holding)

Action control through holding — the capacity to hold experience without premature action, enabling deeper exploration and meta-cognitive awareness.

### Intersubjectivity (間主観性) — Outside M1

Intersubjectivity is not part of the four layers. It is a separate exploration theme concerning the shared experiential space between subjects — how consciousness arises in relational encounters. It is explored alongside M1 but is not one of its layers.

## Research Approach

- **Neurophenomenology**: Bridging first-person phenomenological experience with third-person neuroscience
- **Developmental Psychology**: Tracing how consciousness develops through early encounters
- **Four-Layer Model (M1)**: A structural framework describing the operative structure of consciousness through L0-L3
